## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

The *Hetuduka* (Patthana 14.1) is a text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final work of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Based on the Abhidhamma *mātikā*, the dyad categorizes phenomena into those that are root causes (*hetū dhammā*) and those that are not root causes (*na hetū dhammā*) [U Kyaw Khine 1999]. In the conditional methodology of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it examines causal conditioning between these categories, such as the arising of a not-root phenomenon dependent on a root phenomenon conditioned by root condition (*hetu-paccaya*) [Nyanatiloka 2007].
